setup_legacy_masked_lm_task: setup a LegacyMaskedLMTask instance from args to prepare a BERT masked language model training task
build_bert_dictionary: build a BertDictionary from text filenames with configurable threshold, nwords, and padding factor
load_bert_dictionary: load a BertDictionary from a dict.txt file for use in the masked LM task
load_masked_lm_dataset: load a MaskedLMDataset split using BlockPairDataset with configurable tokens per sample and break mode
add_masked_lm_args: add task-specific CLI arguments for data path, tokens per sample, break mode, and shuffle dataset
